purpose: Connect existing independent meaning-review evidence to plan preparation and fresh intended-use inspection without changing scientific gates or empirical authority.
authority_assessment: Ordinary implementation of D002/D074 and the existing independent-review prerequisite under research-contract/1.0 section 11 and D084. No new estimand, evidence rule, scientific certificate or material scientific-contract change is adopted.

findings.finding: The optional assessment must be host-owned, registered and bound to the exact compiled formalization.
findings.evidence: Wrong target, null/empty references, wrappers and raw review records are rejected before calculation; worker access is denied before dependent reads.

findings.finding: Meaning also depends on the compiled feature definition identity, including parameters and time semantics.
findings.evidence: Inspected strict definition-ID check for every registered review of feature-using targets. The full binding test changes delay_seconds while preserving names/types/units/origin and obtains a mocked positive review; plan preparation rejects it before the child. Literal-only candidates do not require unrelated definitions.

findings.finding: The admitted capsule retains review sources, inherited exposure and historical inspection state.
findings.evidence: Independent tests check exposure preservation, current negative/unverified reviews, a review registered during child execution, interrupted-input retention and rejection of silent same-key refresh.

findings.finding: Completed plan idempotency preserves historical bytes while current inspection recomputes the semantic prerequisite.
findings.evidence: Policy or inventory changes reopen the semantic gate; completed key reuse returns the original record, and a changed assessment reference conflicts. Raw child output and evaluation-policy.py remain unchanged.

findings.finding: Fresh inspection does not grant full plan currency or scientific readiness.
findings.evidence: Only independent_semantic_review can leave the derived gate list. EVALUATION_GAP has a null gate list, all authority flags remain false, and other scientific prerequisites remain open. Documentation requires future atomic freeze to recheck rather than cache this view.

retained_test_preparation_failure.reason: Two independently authored tests attempted a second formalization using a helper whose release target was fixed at epoch 2. The existing controller correctly rejected release into a non-later epoch.
retained_test_preparation_failure.repair: Only the independent fixtures changed: wrong-target assessment does not need a review; unverified-history coverage adds the unverified response to the original target. Production checks were not weakened.

unverified: Provider replies are mocked in this integration; no actual model call, model-quality benchmark or paid API test was performed.
Eleven independent boundary tests stub numeric data resolution; the separately inspected two-test integration supplies actual synthetic data, certification, compilation, execution and child replay.

Fresh prerequisite inspection is not a durable admission token. Scientific data/exposure acceptance, composition conformance, calibrated information/evaluation and atomic allocation/freeze remain separate.
No scientific readiness, market edge, mixed-provider research cycle, publication or deployment completion is established by this review.
Trusted host/operator and operating-system boundaries remain outside the worker isolation guarantee.
